iti83:2.1: (Tik. IV.) Yadā bhikkhave devo devakāyā cavana-dhammo hoti pañca pubbanimittāni pātubhavanti: mālā milāyanti, vatthāni kilissanti, kacchehi sedā muccanti, kāye dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkamati, sake devo devāsane nābhiramatīti. Taṃ-enaṃ bhikkhave devā cavanadhammo ayaṃ devaputto ti iti viditvā tīhi vācāhi anumodanti: Ito bho sugatiṃ gaccha,
iti83:5.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca: Kinnu kho bhante devānaṃ sugatigamanasaṅkhātaṃ,
iti83:9.1: Yaṃ manussabhūto samāno tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ paṭilabhati, idaṃ kho bhikkhave devānaṃ suladdhalābhasaṅkhātaṃ.
iti83:10.1: Sā kho panassa saddhā niviṭṭhā hoti, mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā, daḷhā asaṃhāriyā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ, idaṃ kho bhikkhave devānaṃ suppatiṭṭhitasaṅkhātan-ti.
iti83:12.1: Yadā devo devakāyā cavati āyusaṅkhayā | tayo saddā niccharanti devānaṃ anumodataṃ ||
iti83:13.1: Ito bho sugatiṃ gaccha manussānaṃ sahavyataṃ | manussabhūto saddhamme labha saddhaṃ anuttaraṃ ||
iti83:14.1: Sā te saddhā {niviṭṭhā'ssa} mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā | yāvajīvaṃ asaṃhīrā saddhamme suppavedite ||
iti83:15.1: Kāyaduccaritaṃ hitvā vacīduccaritāni ca | manoduccaritaṃ hitvā yañcaññaṃ dosasaññitaṃ ||
iti83:16.1: Kāyena kusalaṃ katvā vācāya kusalaṃ bahuṃ | manasā kusalaṃ katvā appamāṇaṃ nirūpadhi || tato
iti83:17.1: opadhikaṃ puññaṃ katvā dānena taṃ bahuṃ | aññe pi macce saddhamme brahmacariye nivesaye ||
iti83:18.1: imāya anukampāya devā devaṃ yadā vidū | cavantaṃ anumodanti ehi deva punappunan-ti ||4||
